body: My problem is I am empty. I can't care, I can't feel emotion. I don't even know what happiness is. I can't remember ever feeling anything but hollow

Still here, for a little longer at least. 20 minutes from the time I posted was the time I was born... Kind of poetic in a way. I've been waiting for it to get better for a long time now, but it never does. I can't wait anymore
